title: ESI contribution and benefit periods
description: The two contribution periods of a year with their benefit periods, and the first contribution period of a person who becomes an employee for the first time, in the words of regulation 4 of the Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 1950, in ESIC's consolidated text, kept in force by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020. Each day and month falls at its next occurrence: a period runs from its first day to the next occurrence of its last day, and its benefit period from the next occurrence of its first day after the contribution period ends, as the Table's words “of the year following” place them. Section 164(2)(b) keeps the Regulations “for a period of one year from the date of commencement of this Code”, 21 November 2025 for them, so the rows end on 20 November 2026, the earlier day on which that year may end, and no period is seeded after it. The set answers for the last day of the wage period.

Code on Social Security, 2020 (36 of 2020), section 1(3): “any reference in any such provision to the commencement of this Code shall be construed as a reference to the coming into force of that provision”; S.O. 5319(E), 21 November 2025, serial number 8, as corrected by S.O. 5936(E), 19 December 2025, brought section 164(2) into force on 21 November 2025

cells.name: 1 April to 30 September
cells.wording: 4. Contribution and Benefit periods. Contribution periods and the corresponding benefit periods shall be as under:— [Contribution period] 1st April to 30th September [Corresponding benefit period] 1st January of the year following, to 30th June.

cells.wording: 4. Contribution and Benefit periods. Contribution periods and the corresponding benefit periods shall be as under:— [Contribution period] 1st October to 31st March of the year following [Corresponding benefit period] 1st July to 31st December.

cells.name: First contribution period of a person who becomes an employee for the first time
cells.wording: Provided that in the case of a person who becomes an employee within the meaning of the Act for the first time, the first contribution period shall commence from the date of such employment in the contribution period current on that day and the corresponding benefit period for him shall commence on the expiry of the period of 9 months from the date of such employment.
